# SOP-P3-L4-01 Line startup - Heat Treat line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01, EQ-P3-L4-HT02, EQ-P3-L4-SB03

Purpose
1. Define steps to perform safe startup of the Heat Treat line.

Preconditions
1. Utilities and mainline compressed air are available and stable.
2. All preventive maintenance actions listed in MM-P3-L4-HT02 and MM-P3-L4-SB03 are completed and recorded.
3. ECN-2026-026 approvals for any recent changes are implemented.

Required PPE
1. Safety glasses.
2. Leather gloves rated for work on hot-process equipment.
3. Hearing protection.
4. Flame-resistant clothing.
5. Steel-toe footwear.

Startup Procedure
1. Visual inspection
   1.1 Confirm no loose tools or foreign material in work area around EQ-P3-L4-HT02 and EQ-P3-L4-SB03.
   1.2 Verify guards and access panels on EQ-P3-L4-RR01 are secured.
2. Fastener verification
   2.1 Verify mandrel clamp bolts on EQ-P3-L4-RR01 are torqued to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 605 N·m.
   2.2 Verify blast wheel liner bolts on EQ-P3-L4-SB03 are torqued to the blast wheel liner bolt torque for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 90 N·m.
3. Electrical and control brings-up
   3.1 Place control in local mode and verify indicators for EQ-P3-L4-HT02.
   3.2 Bring drive systems online following control prompts. Observe for abnormal vibration or alarms.
4. Dry cycle
   4.1 Run a no-load dry cycle of the shot blast and ring roll subsystems and confirm proper sequence of interlocks.
5. Process readiness
   5.1 Confirm material flow and handling systems deliver parts to EQ-P3-L4-HT02 without obstruction.
   5.2 Confirm purge and exhaust functions are operating according to station requirements.
6. Production start
   6.1 Start production with the first part under supervised observation. Stop on any abnormal condition.

Deviations
1. Record any deviation and notify maintenance or engineering per ECN-2026-026.

Sign-off
1. Operator name: ____________________
2. Supervisor name: ___________________
3. Date/time started: __________________

Related documents
- ECN-2026-026
- MM-P3-L4-HT02
- MM-P3-L4-SB03
